parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
accuse[əˈkyuːz]v.
To accuse someone of something is to blame them for doing it.
→ She accused her brother of breaking her computer.
😎
adjust[əˈdʒʌst]v.
To adjust something means to change it so it is better.
→ He adjusted the old guitar to make it sound better.
😎
amuse[əˈmyuːz]v.
To amuse someone means to do something that is funny or entertaining.
→ The singer was very good. She amused the crowd.
😎
coral[ˈkɔːrəl]n.
Coral is the hard, colorful material formed by the shells of animals.
→ The diver admired the beautiful coral under the water.
😎
cotton[ˈkɑːtn]n.
Cotton is a cloth made from the fibers of the cotton plant.
→ I like to wear clothes made from cotton in the summer.
😎
crash[kræʃ]v.
To crash means to hit and break something.
→ There was a loud noise when the car crashed into the tree.
😎
deck[dek]n.
A deck is a wooden floor built outside of a house or the floor of a ship.
→ A ship will store many supplies below its deck.
😎
engage[ɪnˈɡeɪdʒ]v.
To engage in something means to do it.
→ Dad was engaged in sawing a piece of wood in half.
😎
firm[fɜːrm]adj.
When something is firm, it is solid but not too hard.
→ He sleeps better on a firm bed.
😎
fuel[ˈfjuːəl]n.
Fuel is something that creates heat or energy.
→ Heat is the fuel that comes from fire.
😎
grand[ɡrænd]adj.
When something is grand, it is big and liked by people.
→ The grand mountain rose high into the sky.
😎
hurricane[ˈhɜːrəkeɪn]n.
A hurricane is a bad storm that happens over the ocean.
→ The wind from the hurricane bent the palm tree.
😎
loss[lɔːs]n.
A loss means the act or an instance of losing something.
→ I suffered a big loss while I was gambling.
😎
plain[pleɪn]adj.
If something is simple, it is plain and not decorated.
→ He bought a pair of plain white shoes over the weekend.
😎
reef[riːf]n.
A reef is a group of rocks or coral that rise to or near the ocean.
→ He walked along the reef and looked at the water below.
😎
shut[ʃʌt]v.
To shut something means to close it tightly.
→ Please shut the door; the air outside is cold.
😎
strict[strɪkt]adj.
When someone is strict, they make sure others follow rules.
→ The teacher is strict. She does not let students talk in class.
😎
surf[sɜːrf]v.
To surf means to use a special board to ride on waves in the ocean.
→ The students went to the beach to surf during their vacation.
😎
task[tæsk]n.
A task is a piece of work to be done that is usually difficult.
→ My task for the weekend was to clean the entire back yard.
😎
zone[zoʊn]n.
A zone is an area that has different qualities from the ones around it.
→ Firefighters often work in danger zones.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the word that is a better fit for each sentence.

questions.content: The _________ for the car is gas.
questions.explanation: Nhiên liệu cho xe hơi là xăng. 'fuel' (nhiên liệu) phù hợp với ngữ cảnh.

questions.content: My favorite shirt is made out of _________.
questions.explanation: Chiếc áo yêu thích của tôi được làm từ bông. 'cotton' (bông/vải cotton) chỉ chất liệu làm áo.

questions.content: The _________ of his job made Steve worry about money.
questions.explanation: Việc mất việc làm khiến Steve lo lắng về tiền bạc. 'loss' (sự mất mát) hợp lý với tình huống lo lắng về tiền bạc.

questions.content: She wanted to _________ that her car was safe, so she locked the door.
questions.explanation: Cô ấy muốn đảm bảo rằng xe của mình an toàn, vì vậy cô đã khóa cửa. 'ensure' (đảm bảo) đi với mệnh đề 'that...'.

questions.content: The boy found a piece of colorful _________ in the ocean.
questions.explanation: Cậu bé tìm thấy một mảnh san hô đầy màu sắc dưới đại dương. 'coral' (san hô) thường được tìm thấy ở đại dương.

questions.content: That group of rocks coming out of the ocean is a _________.
questions.explanation: Nhóm đá nhô lên từ đại dương đó là một rạn san hô. 'reef' (rạn san hô/đá ngầm) phù hợp với định nghĩa nhóm đá trên biển.

questions.content: Funny stories always _________ me.
questions.explanation: Những câu chuyện hài hước luôn làm tôi vui vẻ. 'amuse' (làm cho vui) phù hợp với chủ ngữ 'funny stories'.

questions.content: I _________ quite a bit when I was in Hawaii last summer.
questions.explanation: Tôi đã lướt sóng khá nhiều khi ở Hawaii mùa hè năm ngoái. 'surfed' (lướt sóng) là hoạt động phổ biến ở Hawaii.

questions.content: I was given the _________ of editing his entire manuscript.
questions.explanation: Tôi được giao nhiệm vụ chỉnh sửa toàn bộ bản thảo của anh ấy. 'task' (nhiệm vụ) đi với cấu trúc 'given the task of...'.

questions.content: Don't forget to _________ the door on your way out.
questions.explanation: Đừng quên đóng cửa khi bạn ra ngoài. 'shut' (đóng) đi cùng với tân ngữ 'the door'.

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words from the word bank.
sections.content: Word Bank: accuse, grand, strict, ensure, shut

questions.content: There are [ 11 ] rules about what people may wear at fancy parties.
questions.explanation: Có những quy định nghiêm ngặt về trang phục mọi người được mặc tại các bữa tiệc sang trọng. 'strict' (nghiêm ngặt) bổ nghĩa cho 'rules'.

questions.content: Instead of normal things, people must [ 12 ] that they wear...
questions.explanation: Thay vì những thứ bình thường, mọi người phải đảm bảo rằng họ mặc... 'ensure' (đảm bảo) kết hợp với mệnh đề 'that...'.

questions.content: ...that they wear [ 13 ] clothing.
questions.explanation: ...rằng họ mặc trang phục lộng lẫy. 'grand' (lộng lẫy, sang trọng) phù hợp với bối cảnh bữa tiệc sang trọng.

questions.content: If a man wears the wrong clothes, people will [ 14 ] him of ruining the evening.
questions.explanation: Nếu một người đàn ông mặc sai trang phục, mọi người sẽ buộc tội anh ta làm hỏng buổi tối. Cấu trúc 'accuse someone of something' (buộc tội ai về việc gì).

questions.content: They will make him leave and [ 15 ] the door behind him.
questions.explanation: Họ sẽ yêu cầu anh ta rời đi và đóng cửa lại sau lưng. 'shut' (đóng) đi với tân ngữ 'the door'.

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content: He <u>blamed</u> me of taking the last piece of pie. (ac__________) [ 16 ]
questions.explanation: 'accused' (buộc tội) đồng nghĩa với 'blamed'. Cấu trúc 'accuse someone of something'.

questions.content: The man's bedroom was very <u>simple</u>. (pla____) [ 17 ]
questions.explanation: 'plain' (giản dị, đơn sơ) đồng nghĩa với 'simple'.

questions.content: The clown likes to <u>entertain</u> children. (amu____) [ 18 ]
questions.explanation: 'amuse' (làm cho vui, giải trí) đồng nghĩa với 'entertain'.

questions.content: I need to <u>change</u> the way I run so I can be faster. (adj______) [ 19 ]
questions.explanation: 'adjust' (điều chỉnh) đồng nghĩa với 'change' để làm cho thứ gì đó tốt hơn.

questions.content: During their free time, the children <u>did many different activities</u>. (en___________ in) [ 20 ]
questions.explanation: 'engaged in' (tham gia vào) đồng nghĩa với việc 'did' (thực hiện) các hoạt động.

questions.content: This <u>cloth</u> dress is one of my favorites. (co_________) [ 21 ]
questions.explanation: 'cotton' (vải bông) là chất liệu vải (cloth) quen thuộc.

questions.content: The <u>bad storm over the ocean</u> almost reached the land. (hu_______________) [ 22 ]
questions.explanation: 'hurricane' (bão nhiệt đới) đồng nghĩa với 'bad storm over the ocean' (cơn bão lớn trên đại dương).

questions.content: <u>Tightly close</u> the window before the rain starts! (s______) [ 23 ]
questions.explanation: 'shut' (đóng) đồng nghĩa với 'tightly close' (đóng chặt).

questions.content: He will <u>hit something and break</u> his bike if he closes his eyes while riding. (c_____) [ 24 ]
questions.explanation: 'crash' (đâm sầm, va chạm) đồng nghĩa với 'hit something and break'.

questions.content: The army fights in the war <u>area</u>. (z____) [ 25 ]
questions.explanation: 'zone' (khu vực) đồng nghĩa với 'area'.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Two Captains

Once there were two ships. Both ships carried cotton. The captains were very different. Thomas was strict. He made his crew engage in difficult tasks. "Make sure the ship's deck is firm and that nothing falls! Put more fuel in the tank!" he said. His ship was very plain, but he never had a problem with it.

The second captain, William, was not serious. He had a grand ship, and he loved having fun. His crew amused him by singing and dancing. But his crew never fixed anything on the ship. They just wanted to surf.

One day, Thomas saw a hurricane ahead. He knew that his ship needed to turn around. But he was sure William did not see the storm. He adjusted the dials on the radio and called his friend. Thomas said, "You'll hit the reef. It's made completely of coral. Turn around to ensure that you do not crash."

William said, "We will go under the deck and shut the door. We will dance and sing until we are past the danger zone."

When William's ship got to the hurricane, the wind blew it into the reef. The ship crashed, and water flowed below the deck. William's crew accused him of being a bad captain. The loss of the ship taught William a lesson. There are times to have fun, but there are also times to be serious.

questions.content: 1. What is this story about?
options: b. How Thomas is too strict to be a captain
c. Why people should be serious sometimes
d. Why hurricanes form over the ocean
questions.explanation: Câu chuyện kể về hai vị thuyền trưởng, trong đó sự thiếu nghiêm túc của thuyền trưởng William đã dẫn đến hậu quả tồi tệ là đắm tàu. Từ đó, tác giả đưa ra bài học ở cuối bài: There are times to have fun, but there are also times to be serious (Có lúc để vui chơi, nhưng cũng có lúc phải nghiêm túc). Do đó đáp án C là chính xác.

questions.content: 2. Why did Thomas turn his ship around?
options: a. He saw the hurricane and did not want to crash.
b. He wanted to go to the reef.
c. He could not shut the door.
d. He wanted to engage in other activities.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào câu văn: One day, Thomas saw a hurricane ahead. He knew that his ship needed to turn around (Một ngày nọ, Thomas nhìn thấy một cơn bão phía trước. Anh ấy biết rằng tàu của mình cần phải quay lại). Kèm theo lời cảnh báo của anh với William sau đó: Turn around to ensure that you do not crash. Vì vậy đáp án A là chính xác.

questions.content: 3. Why did William's crew accuse him of being a bad captain?
options: a. William did not go into the storm's danger zone.
b. William caused the loss of the ship.
c. He did not succeed in getting the cotton to its destination.
d. He ensured his crew that they would not crash.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào câu văn: The ship crashed, and water flowed below the deck. William's crew accused him of being a bad captain (Con tàu bị vỡ, và nước tràn xuống dưới boong. Thủy thủ đoàn của William buộc tội anh là một thuyền trưởng tồi). Sự thờ ơ của William đã làm mất con tàu, do đó đáp án B là chính xác.

questions.content: 4. According to the passage, all of the following are true about Thomas EXCEPT
options: a. he told his crew to put fuel in the tank
b. he had his crew make sure the deck was firm
c. he adjusted the radio dial to call William
d. he sang and danced to songs from an opera
questions.explanation: Bài đọc cho biết Thomas yêu cầu đổ thêm nhiên liệu (Put more fuel in the tank), đảm bảo boong tàu vững chắc (Make sure the ship's deck is firm), và anh đã điều chỉnh bộ đàm (He adjusted the dials on the radio). Việc hát và nhảy múa là của thủy thủ đoàn của William (His crew amused him by singing and dancing), không phải của Thomas. Do đó đáp án D là chính xác.

questions.content: 5. What happened when William's ship reached the hurricane?
options: When his ship reached the hurricane the wind blew it into the reef, and it crashed.
The ship safely sailed through the storm.
The crew started singing and dancing.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào câu văn: When William's ship got to the hurricane, the wind blew it into the reef. The ship crashed... (Khi con tàu của William tiến vào cơn bão, gió đã thổi nó vào rạn san hô. Con tàu đã bị vỡ...). Vậy đáp án A là chính xác.
